d: Field of battle on the banks of the Idaspe. Tents and overturned chariots; soldiers, scattered weapons, signs, and other leftovers of the army of Poro of Ptio unleashed by Alexander.
Timagen with bare sword, follow of Macedonians.
Grand pavilion of Alessandro near the Idaspe, overlooking the palace of Cleofide on the other side of the river. Alessandro.
Campaign with tents prepared by Cleofide for the Greek army. Bridge over the Idaspe. Alessandro field arranged in order. Greek soldiers, and then Alexander with Timagen. Cleofide enters.
Cleofide, Poro and Timagen with Guards.
Apartments in the palace of Cleofide. Cleofide and Gandarte.
Porticos of the royal gardens, Poro, then Erissena.
Magnificent temple dedicated to Bacchus, with stake in the middle that then turns on. Pore with style to the hand, and Gandarte.
Alexander and Cleofide, Guards, Bacchanti and Ministers of the Temple enter.
Timagen enters, leading captive Poro. Erissena, Gandarte.
